caption: Attach sources
line: Sources are the files a Squad works from. In the composer, press Attach sources, or drop files in. They appear as chips under Attached sources.

caption: Project, home folder or clone root
line: A source can also come from your home folder or the clone root. Each file can be up to four megabytes, and together they can total sixteen.

caption: Captured when you press Launch
line: Files are captured when you press Launch, so later edits are not included. Credential stores and app data are refused.

caption: Worktree isolation: On, Off or Use default
line: Worktree isolation gives a Squad its own branch and checkout, so it works apart from your folder. You set it on the Squad: On, Off, or Use default.

caption: When a run finishes
line: When a run finishes, the Squad decides what happens to the worktree. Keep it, which is the default, merge it into the base branch, or delete it. Only a completed run is merged or deleted. A failed or stopped run is always kept.

caption: A kept worktree shows in Squad details
line: A kept worktree shows in Squad details, with its path and branch, so you can review the work before you decide.

caption: Attach what it needs, choose where it works
line: Attach what the Squad needs, and choose where it works.
